mapper.select: /*kr.happy.study.asset.statistics.dao.statisticsDao.searchAnnualCategory*/ SELECT tbCg.category_name AS name, tbIn.category_code AS code, SUM(tbIn.quantity) AS quantity FROM tb_product_info AS tbIn, tb_product_import AS tbIm, tb_category_code AS tbCg WHERE tbIn.product_no = tbIm.product_no AND tbCg.category_code = tbIn.category_code AND YEAR(tbIm.import_date) = #{year} GROUP BY tbIn.category_code
/*kr.happy.study.asset.statistics.dao.statisticsDao.searchYear*/ SELECT YEAR(import_date) FROM tb_product_import GROUP BY YEAR(import_date)
